title: Boone County Planning Commission — current Applications and Forms page snapshot
evidenceScope: The current Applications and Forms page directly categorizes Sign Permit as both a checklist and an application, and directly lists Temporary Advertising Display plus three distinct Temporary Commercial Display applications: Incorporated, Seasonal, and Unincorporated. This is current resource/category evidence only; the page does not establish an authenticated online submission workflow, and it does not by itself confirm every requirement, eligibility rule, jurisdiction boundary, instruction, or fee inside the linked PDFs.
